newsitem.title: USA: Four NY teens charged with rape at school.
newsitem.headline: Four NY teens charged with rape at school.

text.p: Four New York City high school students have been charged with the gang rape of a 14-year-old girl on a classroom desk, officials said Wednesday.

A spokeswoman for the Queens District Attorney said two of the suspects used condoms they had allegedly requested from the school guidance counsellor before the attack. She said police recovered a stained desk blotter and condoms from the classroom.

Students at the school in the borough of Queens said the four alleged attackers bragged about the April 16 assault. The girl reported the alleged rape to a school counsellor but education authorities were not told about it until Tuesday. The delay was being investigated.

One of the teenagers allegedly lured the girl into an empty classroom at the August Martin High School on the pretext he wanted to gossip about a mutual friend, the spokeswoman said. When she came to the room, the teens allegedly pushed her inside, pinned her down on the desk, stripped off her clothes and raped her, the spokeswoman said.

The suspects were arrested at the school Monday after police traced the victim and she identified the four teens. They were charged with rape at their arraignment in Queens Criminal Court Tuesday night.
